title: sorbus arbutifolia var. depressa
intro: Sorbus arbutifolia var. depressa, commonly known as Korean Mountain Ash, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to East Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Korean Mountain Ash include being a diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which help to alleviate symptoms such as urinary issues, skin problems, and infections. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
